claims.claim_atom: In the Fig. 1 Source Data, the Fig. 1h shMCT4-1 lactate column (F13,F15,F17 = 61.780736, 58.863296, 75.589952) is byte-identical to six decimals to the Fig. 1i shMCT1-1 column (T15,T17,T19), and the Fig. 1h shMCT4-2 column matches Fig. 1i shMCT1-2 for two of three values. Fig. 1h and Fig. 1i report DIFFERENT gene-knockdown experiments (MCT4 vs MCT1 knockdown), so identical per-replicate values to six decimals cannot both be genuine independent measurements. The first author acknowledged an unintentional copy-paste during Source Data preparation — Fig. 1h data pasted into the Fig. 1i '3028 + TAM supernatant' panel — and provided corrected data.
claims._adjudication: 造假核心-作者已承认(inconsistent): Fig1h shMCT4-1列(F13/F15/F17)与Fig1i shMCT1-1列(T15/T17/T19)6位小数逐位相同, 但1h=shMCT4敲低、1i=shMCT1敲低=不同基因实验, 独立测量不可能逐位同。一作Daqi Li 2026-06-06承认Source Data准备时一次非故意复制粘贴(Fig1h数据误粘入Fig1i '3028+TAM supernatant'面板)并给更正数据。verdict=inconsistent。

claims.claim_atom: Within the same acknowledged panel, the shCONT (control) columns of Fig. 1h (B13,B15,B17 = 112.349696, 116.628608, 113.711168) and Fig. 1i (P15,P17,P19 = 102.624896, 106.903808, 109.237760) are DIFFERENT values, showing the two experiments' control data are genuinely independent. The duplication is therefore a localized copy-paste of the knockdown columns during Source Data assembly, not a wholesale fabrication of the figure; consistent with the author's account that the corrected data do not change the conclusions.
claims._adjudication: 合法子断言(consistent): 同面板的shCONT对照列两图取值不同(B13-B17 vs P15-P19), 证两实验对照数据真独立→复制粘贴是敲低列的局部错误(Source Data整理阶段), 非整图编造。支持作者'更正不改结论'的说法。AI应把误粘定为局部展示层错误, 不因此判整图造假。

claims.claim_atom: Beyond the acknowledged Fig. 1h/1i copy-paste, later PubPeer comments flagged further repeated values in the Fig. 2h MES28 CellTiter-Glo time-course (e.g. Day-5 replicate values S32 = W32 = 2.901216; commenter reports 4 of 6 replicates reordered/reused between shCONT and shMCT1-2 + MCT1-rescue) and in Extended Data Fig. 3b/3c (Day-1 values identical across different treatment conditions). These have received no author response as of this writing and cannot be adjudicated as additional copy-paste errors, reordering artifacts, or coincidences pending the authors' explanation and any correction.
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): Fig2h MES28 CellTiter时间序列有重复值(如Day5 S32=W32=2.901216), 评论者称shCONT与shMCT1-2+rescue间4/6重复被重排复用; ED Fig3b/3c Day1跨条件同值。截至整理均无作者回应, 无法判定是否另有复制/重排错误还是巧合, 待作者解释与可能的更正。verdict=insufficient。
